civmodern.screen.radar.pings.tooltip: Hear a ping anytime someone enters or leaves your radar?

civmodern.screen.radar.log.tooltip: Allows radar distance to be displayed logarithmically: players nearby will be much more spread out while still maintaining the max distance
civmodern.screen.items.title: Civ Modern Config (Items)

civmodern.screen.ice.title: Civ Modern Config (Ice Road Macro)
civmodern.screen.ice.cardinal.pitch.tool: Should your camera snap its pitch (up/down) when activating the iceroad macro?
civmodern.screen.ice.cardinal.yaw.toolti: Should your camera snap its yaw (left/right) when activating the iceroad macro?
civmodern.screen.ice.stop.tooltip: Automatically stop the ice-road macro when critically hungry?
civmodern.screen.map.title: Civ Modern Config (Map)
civmodern.screen.newwaypoint.title: Create Waypoint
civmodern.map.boat.tooltip:
Use while in a boat or riding a steerable animal
Right click to place a navigation waypoint
Shift right click to delete a waypoint
Control right click or dismount to stop
civmodern.map.players.tooltip: Display players that trigger snitches on the map
civmodern.map.waypoints.tooltip: Display waypoints on the map and minimap
civmodern.screen.waypoints.title: Waypoints
civmodern.map.nodes.tooltip:
Show node territory over the map
Click to cycle solid, translucent, and hidden
Hides the layer only; node data keeps updating
civmodern.map.nodes.tooltip.frozen: §7Querying is off, so this shows cached territory only
civmodern.screen.nodes.title: Civ Modern Config (Node Overlay)
civmodern.screen.nodes.query.tooltip: Keep asking the server for node data. Turning this off freezes the overlay on what is already cached; it does not hide it. Use the button on the map to hide the layer.
civmodern.screen.nodes.borders.tooltip: Outline the seams between nodes, and between territory and open ground, when zoomed in
civmodern.screen.nodes.grid.tooltip: Dash a slim line around every chunk inside a node, so single chunks can be counted off without mistaking one for the edge of the node
civmodern.screen.nodes.unclaimed.tooltip: Paint nodes nobody has claimed, in grey. Turning this off leaves them as bare map, so only territory somebody holds is coloured in.
civmodern.screen.nodes.handshake.tooltip: Re-announce this mod to the server. Use this if the overlay did not connect when you joined.
civmodern.nodes.status.waiting: Waiting for the server to respond...
civmodern.nodes.status.ready: Connected to '%s' (window up to %s, %s ms between queries)
civmodern.nodes.status.nonodes: This world has no node map
civmodern.nodes.status.disabled: The server has the node API turned off
civmodern.nodes.status.timedout: No response: this server does not serve node data
civmodern.nodes.handshake.sent: Handshake sent, waiting for a reply...
civmodern.nodes.handshake.failed: Could not re-register the node channel
